# ENCE and MICE - Serial vs Synchronous Metrics Across Missingness/Cutoff Levels



## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# Cutoff tags (%) to sweep over - matches round(cutoff * 100) from
# synchronous_vs_serial.Rmd / synchronous_vs_serial_mice.Rmd.
# Edit this if the actual cutoff values used for the running jobs differ.
cutoffs <- c(30, 50, 70, 90)

ence_files <- sprintf("section_4_1_ENCE_sync_vs_serial_cutoff%02d.rds", cutoffs)
mice_files <- sprintf("section_4_1_MICE_sync_vs_serial_cutoff%02d.rds", cutoffs)
names(ence_files) <- cutoffs
names(mice_files) <- cutoffs
```

## Helper Functions

```{r helper_functions, message=FALSE}
load_if_exists <- function(path) {
  if (file.exists(path)) readRDS(path) else NULL
}

compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
  rmse     <- sqrt(mean((pred - true)^2))
  bias_pct <- sum(pred - true) / sum(true) * 100
  r2       <- 1 - sum((pred - true)^2) / sum((true - mean(true))^2)
  srmse    <- rmse / mean(true)
  c(RMSE = rmse, Bias_pct = bias_pct, R2 = r2, SRMSE = srmse)
}

plot_obs_pred <- function(observed, predicted, method_name = "Method") {
  op <- par(pty = "s")
  on.exit(par(op))
  lims <- range(c(observed, predicted), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(observed, predicted,
       xlim = lims, ylim = lims,
       xlab = "Observed", ylab = "Predicted",
       main = paste(method_name, ": Observed vs Predicted"),
       pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.12))
  abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
  grid()
}
```

## Load available data

```{r load_data, results='hold'}
ence_data <- lapply(ence_files, load_if_exists)
mice_data <- lapply(mice_files, load_if_exists)

cat("ENCE files:\n")
for (i in seq_along(ence_files)) {
  status <- if (is.null(ence_data[[i]])) {
    "MISSING"
  } else {
    m <- ence_data[[i]]$meta
    sprintf("OK  (meta cutoff=%.2f, K=%d, stations=%d)", m$cutoff, m$K, m$n_stations)
  }
  cat(sprintf("  cutoff%02d  %-45s  %s\n", cutoffs[i], ence_files[i], status))
}

cat("\nMICE files:\n")
for (i in seq_along(mice_files)) {
  status <- if (is.null(mice_data[[i]])) {
    "MISSING"
  } else {
    m <- mice_data[[i]]$meta
    sprintf("OK  (meta cutoff=%.2f, K=%d, stations=%d)", m$cutoff, m$K, m$n_stations)
  }
  cat(sprintf("  cutoff%02d  %-45s  %s\n", cutoffs[i], mice_files[i], status))
}
```

## Build summary table

```{r build_summary, message=FALSE}
build_summary <- function(data_list, cutoffs, engine_name) {
  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(data_list)) {
    d <- data_list[[i]]
    if (is.null(d)) next

    serial_m <- compute_metrics(d$true_y, d$serial_y)
    sync_m   <- compute_metrics(d$true_y, d$sync_y)
    speedup  <- d$serial_time / d$sync_time

    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Engine   = engine_name,
      Cutoff   = cutoffs[i],
      Update   = "Serial",
      Time_s   = round(d$serial_time, 2),
      RMSE     = round(unname(serial_m["RMSE"]), 4),
      Bias_pct = round(unname(serial_m["Bias_pct"]), 3),
      R2       = round(unname(serial_m["R2"]), 4),
      SRMSE    = round(unname(serial_m["SRMSE"]), 4),
      Speedup  = NA_real_
    )
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Engine   = engine_name,
      Cutoff   = cutoffs[i],
      Update   = "Synchronous",
      Time_s   = round(d$sync_time, 2),
      RMSE     = round(unname(sync_m["RMSE"]), 4),
      Bias_pct = round(unname(sync_m["Bias_pct"]), 3),
      R2       = round(unname(sync_m["R2"]), 4),
      SRMSE    = round(unname(sync_m["SRMSE"]), 4),
      Speedup  = round(speedup, 2)
    )
  }
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

ence_summary <- build_summary(ence_data, cutoffs, "ENCE")
mice_summary <- build_summary(mice_data, cutoffs, "MICE")
```


```{r mice_summary_print, results='hold'}
}
```

## Scatterplots (sanity check)

```{r ence_scatterplots, results='hold'}
for (i in seq_along(ence_data)) {
  d <- ence_data[[i]]
  if (is.null(d)) next
  plot_obs_pred(d$true_y, d$serial_y, sprintf("ENCE Serial - cutoff %d%%", cutoffs[i]))
  plot_obs_pred(d$true_y, d$sync_y,   sprintf("ENCE Synchronous - cutoff %d%%", cutoffs[i]))
}
```

```{r mice_scatterplots, results='hold'}

  plot_obs_pred(d$true_y, d$serial_y, sprintf("MICE Serial - cutoff %d%%", cutoffs[i]))
```

## Save combined summary (for LaTeX table later)

```{r save_summary}
combined <- rbind(ence_summary, mice_summary)
if (!is.null(combined)) {
  saveRDS(combined, "section_4_1_missingness_sweep_summary.rds")
  write.csv(combined, "section_4_1_missingness_sweep_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved summary table with", nrow(combined), "rows.\n")
}
```
